MOD = 998244353

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    m = int(data[1])
    l = int(data[2])
    r = int(data[3])

    d = r - l + 1
    a = d // 2
    b = d - a
    nm = n * m
    diff = abs(a - b)

    ans = (pow(d, nm, MOD) + pow(diff, nm, MOD)) % MOD
    ans = (ans * 499122177) % MOD
    if nm % 2 == 1:
        ans = pow(d, nm, MOD)
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
